name: AOWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned once in the held record: a scored four-way contest on the finale of the alliance's first event (AOWF, November 1999) — first to three falls wins — Nightshade defeating Shame, Savage Warrior, and Chaos, each entering as a champion or top contender of one of the alliance's own four founding member federations.

name: AOWF Television Championship
epitaph: A unification match on Day 2 of the alliance's first event pitted four member feds' own reigning television champions (V.I.G. of the WCIWA, The Charm of the ICWL, Golden One of the UWF, and Blade of the WWFL) for one new supra-fed title — the served text cuts off mid-match with no winner shown, though Day 4's own broadcast confirms a champion existed by that point. Every AOWF title, including this one, was declared vacant at the opening of AOWF_2; the held record's only confirmed reign is Tommy Riley's own win of a three-way Ladder Match there, over Chad Hazzard and Stephen "the Monkey" MacDonald.
